description: This PHP source file defines a class 'registry_v2_1' that extends 'registry'. The class registers functions and complex types related to a web service, specifically for the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM system. It includes methods for registering functions and complex data types such as link lists and entry lists used in the service.

classes.name: registry_v2_1
classes.description: A class extending 'registry' that registers functions and complex types for SuiteCRM's web service infrastructure.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers all functions for the service, calling the parent method and logging the start and end.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in the web service, extending parent types and adding new structured types for links and entries.
